title: Five questions that make a better brief
excerpt: You do not need a formal document to start a design project. You need honest answers to five questions, most of them about your customers.
content:
You do not need a formal document to start a design project. You need honest answers to five questions, and most of them are about your customers rather than about design.

  • Who has to notice this, and where will they be when they do?
  • What do they believe about you today?
  • What should they do next?
  • What must not change?
  • How will we know it worked?

The one people skip

The fourth question is the one that saves projects. Every company has something its customers are quietly attached to: a colour, a phrase, the way the box opens. Find it before the redesign does.

Send me your answers, however rough, and we can take it from there.
